name: CuQooTalk
source: The protagonist, Minjae, joins an exchange student program for a short two week period, traveling from his university in Korea to the US. Meanwhile, Malik stays in Minjae’s home, where he meets his [s]new victims[/s] Minjae’s family. Experience Minjae’s [s]hellish[/s] life through the screen of his phone.
translation: 主人公Minjae参加了一个为期两周的交换生计划，从韩国的大学前往美国。与此同时，马利克留在Minjae的家里，在那里他遇到了[s]新受害者[/s] Minjae的家人。通过Minjae的手机屏幕体验他的[s]hellish[/s]生活。
